title: Lundey journeys
description: An invited player's experience of Lundey, as the README describes the game and as the Worker and the page lead a player through it.

entities.name: A run at the best score
entities.description: An invited player signs in, learns the hunters from the title screen, plays burrow after burrow and comes back to beat their own best.
entities.goal: Get further into the burrows than last time, and beat the best score on their device.

stages.context: Has been invited (holds games:lundey) and arrives at icelander.net/games/lundey/ signed out.
stages.action: Signs in, and is sent back to the game.
stages.outcome: The title screen: the four hunters and how each hunts, what a tern's feather does, and the keys. Someone signed in at an address that was not invited sees a page saying so instead.

stages.context: The title screen, or the demo it plays when left alone for twelve seconds.
stages.touchpoint: The game's screen: Enter, a tap, the PLAY button or a gamepad
stages.outcome: BURROW 1, READY!, with three puffins, and the puffin at home under the hunters' den.

stages.context: The fox is out at once; the mink, the skua and the raven follow from the den.
stages.touchpoint: The game's screen, with the arrow keys or WASD, swipes, the on-screen buttons or a gamepad
stages.action: Gathers every sand eel, takes a tern's feather to turn on the hunters, and picks up the treats that wash up.
stages.outcome: BURROW CLEARED, and a new burrow in the next season, with faster hunters and terns that stay less long.

stages.action: Reads the score, and presses Enter or taps to play again.
stages.outcome: A score better than the best is kept on this device and shown as BEST from then on.

stages.touchpoint: BEST, at the top of the screen
stages.outcome: The best score is still there to beat. On another device, or in a private window, it starts from 0.

relatedViews.relationship: The use case behind the journey's stages.
How the page is fetched, and who is turned away.
